## About NeuraWeb

NeuraWeb is a French digital agency based in Paris, specializing in:
- Custom web development (React, Next.js, TypeScript)
- Mobile app development (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter)
- AI integration (ChatGPT, Claude, open-source models)
- Business automation (n8n, Make)

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Location: Paris, Ile-de-France, France
- Service Areas: France, Belgium, Switzerland
- Languages: French, English, Spanish
- Contact: contact@neuraweb.tech
- Phone: +33 7 49 77 56 54

## Pricing

- Starter Pack: 1,500 EUR (Responsive showcase site with SEO)
- Business Pack: 3,500 EUR (Complete solution with admin, blog, analytics)
- Premium Pack: 6,000 EUR (E-commerce, third-party APIs, 24/7 support)
- AI Pack: Custom quote
